question: Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?

sentences.en: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service.
sentences.zh: 本·福西特上尉购买了一架不同寻常的“出租车”，并开始了一项新业务。

sentences.en: The 'taxi' is a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'.
sentences.zh: 这架“出租车”是一架名为“皮拉图斯搬运工”的瑞士小型飞机。

sentences.en: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
sentences.zh: 这架奇妙的飞机能载七名乘客。

sentences.en: The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
sentences.zh: 然而，它最令人惊讶的地方是它能降落在任何地方：雪地、水面，甚至是一块耕过的田地。

sentences.en: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.
sentences.zh: 福西特上尉的第一位乘客是一位医生，他从伯明翰飞到威尔士山区的一个偏僻村庄。

sentences.en: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，福西特上尉已载送乘客去过许多不寻常的地方。

sentences.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.
sentences.zh: 他曾有一次降落在公寓楼的屋顶上，还有一次降落在废弃的停车场里。

sentences.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
sentences.zh: 福西特上尉刚刚拒绝了一位商人提出的一个奇怪请求。

sentences.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean,
sentences.zh: 那位商人想飞到大西洋中的一座孤岛——罗科尔岛，

sentences.en: but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但福西特上尉没有载他，因为那次飞行太危险了。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作或状态，与现在有联系或对现在有影响。通常与 already, yet, just, recently, since, for 等时间状语连用。
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 描述过去的动作对现在造成的影响，或表示动作持续到现在。本课中 has bought, has begun, has just refused 都使用了现在完成时。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi.
examples.zh: 福西特机长买了一辆不寻常的出租车。

examples.en: He has just refused a strange request.
examples.zh: 他刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

examples.en: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
examples.zh: 从那以后，福西特机长载送乘客到过许多不寻常的地方。

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，常与具体的时间状语连用，如 yesterday, last week, in 2020 等。
grammar.usage: 描述在过去某个特定时间发生的动作，不强调与现在的关系。本课中 flew, landed, wanted 都使用了过去式。

examples.en: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham.
examples.zh: 福西特机长的第一位乘客是一位从伯明翰飞来的医生。

examples.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
examples.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

examples.en: The man wanted to fly to Rockall.
examples.zh: 那个人想要飞往罗卡尔岛。

grammar.title: too + 形容词 + to do (太...而不能)
grammar.definition: too 后面接形容词，to do 表示结果，意为"太...以至于不能..."，表示由于程度过高而无法做某事。
grammar.structure: too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 表示程度过高导致不可能做某事，to 后面接动词原形。本课中 too dangerous 就是这种用法。

examples.en: The trip was too dangerous.
examples.zh: 这趟旅行太危险了。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，搬不动。

examples.en: He is too young to understand.
examples.zh: 他太年轻了，理解不了。

patterns.pattern: Has + 主语 + 过去分词...? (现在完成时一般疑问句)

original.en: Has Captain Fawcett bought an unusual taxi?
original.zh: 福西特机长买了一辆不寻常的出租车吗？

examples.en: Has she begun a new service?
examples.zh: 她开始了一项新服务吗？

examples.en: Has he flown to many unusual places?
examples.zh: 他飞去过许多不寻常的地方吗？

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have + just + 过去分词 (刚刚...)

original.en: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request.
original.zh: 福西特机长刚刚拒绝了一个奇怪的请求。

examples.en: I have just finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我刚刚完成作业。

examples.en: He has just arrived at the airport.
examples.zh: 他刚刚到达机场。

patterns.pattern: too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形 (太...而不能)

original.en: The trip was too dangerous to take.
original.zh: 这趟旅行太危险了，不能去。

examples.en: The problem is too difficult to solve.
examples.zh: 这个问题太难了，解决不了。

examples.en: The coffee is too hot to drink now.
examples.zh: 咖啡太烫了，现在不能喝。

patterns.pattern: once + 主语 + 过去式 (有一次/曾经)

original.en: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats.
original.zh: 有一次他降落在了一栋公寓楼的屋顶上。

examples.en: Once she visited Paris.
examples.zh: 有一次她去了巴黎。

examples.en: Once he lost his wallet on the train.
examples.zh: 有一次他在火车上丢了钱包。
